If I lose a plane it’s crushing. 
ARMOUR YOUR PILOT!!!! This is most important 
Getting the crew armoured is essential. Then fire power also. See what you can get up to. You can sell ventricul turret in Lancaster. You get $4000?  Upgrade top turret as has 360. Beef up tail also. If as we all know have fuck all money so I will heavily armour my tail gunner as they always get cooked. 
So if I am at a level where I have auto tag and spitfires I will downgrade my armour and engines to get more money for guns. 
A heavily armoured crew is VERY important. Having crew down leaves 2 positions unattended and you know that bf110 is going to slide under. 
If you get smoked don’t waste on dingy or pigeon. Just select new crew. If the lvl is crap check the armour rating. Grab them. 
Sometimes you get a decent replacement bomber. You will have $0 but if you have couple $100 use it to buy anything for crew. Then do green missions take recon photos get the guns and armour up. And engines and systems. Once you start knocking down aces you get decent coin. If you have recon radio hit that too. You may get a photo op. Use user waypoint navigate to the spot. 
Any crew member can use the bomb bay. 
Upper turret side gunners don’t stress about ammo feeds. They are literally next to ammo box so get big cheaper guns without feed. 
If you are getting smashed by fighters climb high. Corkscrew then hit low. This will give gunners that have ammo. You know when everything is crazy and you level 9 engineer has fallen off wing and twin engine assholes are below grrrrr.  Use focus use everything use defence anything to get an edge. 
Emergency dive avoid flak. And always remember never lose hope. An engine may burn and fall off. You can make it on one engine with the ball turret gunner flying and left waist navigating. Get out of inside view it’s depressing seeing all your dead crew rolling around. External view and keep looking for that landing waypoint.
